notes: Source: official JVC instruction manual B5A-4107-00 (covers KY-PZ400NWU/NWE/NBU/NBE and KY-PZ200 series), Names of Parts (p.16) and Specifications/Terminal Section (p.46), cross-checked against jvc.com US/UK/EU/India product pages (all consistent). This manual is shared across the PZ400 and PZ200 series; features/ports tagged "200N/200" in the manual are PZ200-only and were excluded — notably the USB 3.0 (USB-B) terminal is PZ200-series only, so KY-PZ400 has USB 2.0 (USB-A) only. RS-232 IN/OUT and the video/tally rear jacks use 8-pin mini-DIN connectors; the connector enum has no mini-DIN option, so "midi-din" (5-pin MIDI DIN) was chosen as the closest available id — physically it is an 8-pin mini-DIN, not a MIDI/audio connector. RS-485 is a 2-pin Phoenix captive-screw terminal block; mapped to "euroblock" as the closest available id. LAN port PoE input is rated "DC 37 to 57V" per the spec table; JVC's Main Features page separately states the camera supports "dual power supply (PoE and DC IN 12V)" and marketing pages describe it as PoE+ (802.3at, 42-57V) while the base standard PoE range (37-48V, 802.3af) is also covered — treated here simply as PoE over the RJ45 Ethernet port. HDMI is stated to output up to "2160/30p,25p" with no explicit HDMI version number in the manual; grade hdmi-2.0 is inferred from JVC's own product marketing pages (jvc.com/usa and uk.jvc.com) which explicitly list "HDMI 2.0". No genlock, tally-GPIO, or additional audio ports exist on this model. Camera ships with an external AC/DC adapter and a fixed captive DC 12V barrel-type power terminal on the unit (not a detachable IEC cord on the camera body itself).

ports.name: 3G-SDI
ports.note: BNC type; supports 720p/1080i/1080p with embedded audio; 3G-SDI per SMPTE ST424, HD-SDI per SMPTE ST292

ports.name: LAN
ports.note: RJ-45; 10BASE-T/100BASE-TX/1000BASE-T; also supplies PoE power in (DC 37-57V)

ports.name: USB 2.0
ports.note: USB-A type terminal, present on KY-PZ400 (USB 3.0/USB-B is a KY-PZ200-series-only feature, not on PZ400)

ports.name: RS232 IN
ports.note: 8-pin mini DIN; closest listed connector id is midi-din (physically an 8-pin mini DIN serial port, not MIDI). Supports Standard/Pelco-D/Pelco-P protocols

ports.name: RS232 OUT
ports.note: 8-pin mini DIN; closest listed connector id is midi-din. For daisy-chaining; Standard protocol network only

ports.name: RS485
ports.note: 2-pin Phoenix (captive screw) terminal block; closest listed id is euroblock. Supports Standard/Pelco-D/Pelco-P protocols, half duplex

ports.name: DC 12V
ports.note: For use with supplied AC/DC adapter; JVC coaxial DC power jack. Camera also supports dual power via PoE on the LAN port
